description: Search the live NullClear Ecosystem Directory for audited, high-uptime x402 & ERC-8004 APIs by topic/keyword, category, minimum uptime, or max latency. Automatically returns the NullClear-protected Zero-Loss Proxy URL ('https://api.nullclear.dev/https://...') for each endpoint.

maxLatencyMs.description: Maximum acceptable edge round-trip latency in ms (default 2000)

minUptime.description: Minimum rolling uptime score percentage (0-100, default 95)

verifiedOnly.description: Only return verified x402 endpoints (default true)

name: nullclear_discover_verified_x402_apis
